title: What type of label is not on molecules with atoms with tin?
question: What type of label is not on molecules with atoms with tin?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1.label
FROM LabelInfo AS T1
WHERE T1.molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id
    FROM atom AS T2
    WHERE T2.element = 'sn'
)
